commit_message:
[GlobalOpt] Fix crash in RaiseSpecialOps on buffer-semantics named ops

NamedImplicitCastOpConversion indexed getResultTypes()[0], which asserts
(TypeRange.h:156) on a buffer-semantics linalg op since it has no results.
A linalg.matmul with memref operands therefore crashed iree-compile with a
hard abort instead of a clean diagnostic.

Guard on hasPureTensorSemantics() before reasoning about results / rewriting
the body, matching the other patterns in this file (lines 48, 231). The op is
left untouched and compilation proceeds normally.

Fixes #24624

Signed-off-by: Alex-Wengg <hanweng9@gmail.com>

commit_message:
[Flow] Fold static flow.tensor.empty shapes into dims (#24622)

This PR Adds a canonicalization pattern for `flow.tensor.empty` that
folds constant dynamic dimension operands into the static result shape.

**Example :**

%0 = flow.tensor.empty : tensor<?x4xf32>{%c8}

**canonicalizes to:**

%0 = flow.tensor.empty : tensor<8x4xf32>
%cast = tensor.cast %0 : tensor<8x4xf32> to tensor<?x4xf32>

The cast preserves the original result type for existing users while
allowing downstream canonicalization to use the refined static shape.

[Flow] Fold static flow.tensor.empty shapes into dims (#24622)

This PR Adds a canonicalization pattern for `flow.tensor.empty` that
folds constant dynamic dimension operands into the static result shape.

**Example :**

%0 = flow.tensor.empty : tensor<?x4xf32>{%c8}

**canonicalizes to:**

%0 = flow.tensor.empty : tensor<8x4xf32>
%cast = tensor.cast %0 : tensor<8x4xf32> to tensor<?x4xf32>

The cast preserves the original result type for existing users while
allowing downstream canonicalization to use the refined static shape.

commit_message:
[GlobalOpt] Fix crash in RaiseSpecialOps on buffer-semantics named ops

NamedImplicitCastOpConversion indexed getResultTypes()[0], which asserts
(TypeRange.h:156) on a buffer-semantics linalg op since it has no results.
A linalg.matmul with memref operands therefore crashed iree-compile with a
hard abort instead of a clean diagnostic.

Guard on hasPureTensorSemantics() before reasoning about results / rewriting
the body, matching the other patterns in this file (lines 48, 231). The op is
left untouched and compilation proceeds normally.

Fixes #24624
